label: confirmatory-config-locked-before-completion
question: Does the fixed 64-step RelTwin-SetPO recipe improve SpotSound-Bench across three independently trained seeds?
causal_rationale: Set-aware candidate preference and relation-exchange equivariance should reduce wrong-window selection without sacrificing ordinary audio grounding.
code_config_delta: No delta from the locked seed-0 recipe: 64 steps, lr=2e-6, method_weight=0.5, exchange_weight=1.0, rehearsal_weight=0.5 every 4 steps, target_temperature=0.15, jitter_ratio=0.15.
baseline: Official SpotSound-A adapter evaluated by the same 400-record harness.
evaluator: Frozen SpotSound temporal-set IoU protocol plus the audited Auto-AEG-compatible interval metrics.
diagnostics: paired per-record bootstrap delta versus SpotSound-A
checkpoint_policy: Final adapter after exactly 64 steps; no validation or test checkpoint selection.
resource_estimate: Two remaining full evaluations on one 32GB GPU, under 0.5 GPU-hours total.
success_criterion: Mean improvement is positive across all three seeds and the paired stratified 95% bootstrap CI for the seed-averaged per-record mIoU delta excludes zero.
failure_criterion: Any seed materially regresses or the seed-averaged mIoU confidence interval includes zero.
stop_criterion: Do not tune this recipe on SpotSound-Bench after observing E001; any subsequent method must be selected on independent RelTwin/ESC-50 diagnostics before a new locked evaluation.
timing_note: Written while seed-1 evaluation had produced 21/400 records and before any seed-1/2 aggregate metric was observed. Seed-0 had been observed previously.
